SELECT 
    T3.WhsName AS "location",
    T1.ItemCode AS "code",
    T0.DocDate AS "date",
    T1.Quantity AS "quantity"
FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OINV T0
JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.INV1 T1 ON T1.DocEntry = T0.DocEntry
JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode
WHERE 
T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND
T0.DocDate  BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() as DATE)
Order By T1.WhsCode, T1.ItemCode, T0.DocDate

    T3.WhsName AS "location",
    T1.ItemCode AS "code",
    T0.DocDate AS "date",
    T1.Quantity AS "quantity"
FROM [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.OINV T0
JOIN [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.INV1 T1 ON T1.DocEntry = T0.DocEntry
JOIN [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_VID_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode
WHERE 
T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND
T0.DocDate  BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() as DATE)
Order By T1.WhsCode, T1.ItemCode, T0.DocDate

SELECT 
    T3.WhsName AS "location",
    T1.ItemCode AS "code",
    T0.DocDate AS "date",
    T1.Quantity AS "quantity"
FROM [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.OINV T0
JOIN [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.INV1 T1 ON T1.DocEntry = T0.DocEntry
JOIN [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.OITM T2 ON T2.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
JOIN [DB_IMNAC_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 ON T3.WhsCode = T1.WhsCode
WHERE 
T0.U_DOC_DECLARABLE = 'S' AND
T0.DocDate  BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND CAST(GETDATE() as DATE)
Order By T1.WhsCode, T1.ItemCode, T0.DocDate

SELECT
    T3.WhsName           AS "location",
    T0.ItemCode          AS "code",
    T0.ItemName          AS "description",
    'finished'           AS "materialType",
    CAST(T0.NumInBuy AS INT) AS "multipleOrderQuantity",
    'USD'                AS "currency",
    T0.AvgPrice          AS "unitCost",
    CAST('1' AS INT)     AS "minimumOrderQuantity",
    'units'              AS "unitOfMeasure",
    CAST(ISNULL(T9.U_DIAS_PRODUCCION, 0) AS INT) AS "supplyLeadTime",
    T1.OnHand            AS "onHandStock",
    T1.OnOrder           AS "transitStock",
    T1.IsCommited        AS "openDemandOrders",
    T2.CompnyName        AS "additionalColA",
    T6.ItmsGrpNam        AS "additionalColB",
    T9.U_DIAS_TRANSITO AS transitDays,
    T9.U_DIAS_NACIONALIZACION_PUERTO AS nationalGyeDays,
    T9.U_DIAS_NACIONALIZACION_UIO AS nationalUioDays,
    CASE 
        WHEN T8.CardCode = 'P20532416036' THEN 'P8300318491'
        ELSE T8.CardCode
    END AS CardCode,
    CASE 
        WHEN T8.SuppName = 'PRATAC S.A.' THEN 'PERNOD RICARD COLOMBIA S.A.'
        ELSE T8.SuppName
    END AS SuppName
FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITM T0
INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITW T1 
    ON T0.ItemCode = T1.ItemCode
INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OITB T6 
    ON T0.ItmsGrpCod = T6.ItmsGrpCod
INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OWHS T3 
    ON T1.WhsCode = T3.WhsCode
CROSS JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OADM T2
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        T7.ItemCode,
        MAX(T8.DocEntry) AS LatestDocEntry
    FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.IPF1 T7
    INNER JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OIPF T8 
        ON T7.DocEntry = T8.DocEntry
    WHERE T8.DocDate > '2000-01-01'
    GROUP BY T7.ItemCode
) LatestIPF 
    ON T0.ItemCode = LatestIPF.ItemCode
LEFT JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OIPF T8 
    ON LatestIPF.LatestDocEntry = T8.DocEntry
LEFT JOIN [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OCRD T9 ON (T8.CardCode  = T9.CardCode )
WHERE  T1.WhsCode IN (
 SELECT WhsCode 
        FROM [DB_CORDOVEZ_PROD].dbo.OWHS 
        WHERE WhsName != 'VITRINA' and WhsName != 'BODEGA MAL ESTADO UIO'
    )
    AND T0.validFor = 'Y'
    AND T8.CardCode IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
